card.name: Journal names and years in citations
card.fires_on: Journal title, volume and year positions inside reference-list citations, just before the volume, issue or page numbers. It fires on the last piece of a journal name or on the punctuation or space after it.

modes.label: End of journal name
modes.description: The last part of an abbreviated or full journal title right before the volume number.

modes.label: Punctuation before volume or year
modes.description: A space, comma or period after the journal name or year, just before the volume and page numbers.

card.plain: It marks the spot in a reference-list citation where the journal name ends and the volume and page numbers begin.
